error[L0331]: this call returns nothing, so its `else` has no result to stand in for
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/none-call-else-value-becomes-else-none/program.ldn:10:24
   |
10 |     attempt(true) else 0
   |                        ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/none-call-else-value-becomes-else-none/program.ldn:5:1
  |
5 | attempt: (flag: bool) -> none ! refused =
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ this signature returns none
  = note: [1030]: `else none` ignores the error, and `else (problem) ... end` handles it in a block; neither yields a value
  = help: ignore the failure with `else none`
